description: Read one F32 or F64 Safetensors tensor and group finite values into histogram bins. Count NaN and infinity separately. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. Tensor name is required when the file contains more than one tensor. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: tensor_histogram
title: Plot a tensor histogram
